name: Jagruti Badgujar
intro: Tech consultant at Winjit Technologies (RIB Group) and MSc Software Engineering student at the University of Limerick. I build .NET and Azure systems for lending and finance, and help teams use AI in real delivery.
story: I started at Winjit Technologies (RIB Group) in Nashik as an intern in 2020 and grew to Consultant, delivering enterprise platforms for lending, ERP integration, accounting and manufacturing.

Along the way I brought AI into how my teams work. Now I am doing an MSc in Software Engineering (Architecture and Project Management) at the University of Limerick and completing Azure AI Engineer (AI-102).
